Clinical Treatment Summary
The patient presented following a sideswipe clolision that occurred during a lane change, with complaints of low back pain and
muscle strain. The mechanism of injury and the force involved are cnosistent with the lumabr strain diagnosed. Over five office
visits, care followed a typical conservative course, including rest, activity modification, physical therapy, and a home eexrcise
program. Symptoms improved steadily, and visit frequency was reduced as function returned.
Imaging and physical examination findings support the diagnosis. Palpation revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness with restricted
range of motion, and the imaging results corroborate soft tissue injury to the lumbar region.
The patient's history includes treatment for the same body area within the past two years. That prior condition is likely
contributing to some of the current symptoms and should be considered when evaluating the overall clinical picture.
Billing records for this episode of care reflect each service once, with no duplicated charges.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
